newsitem.title: EGYPT: Three suspected militants found dead in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Three suspected militants found dead in Egypt.

text.p: Three suspected Moslem militants were found dead in southern Egypt on Thursday by police forces that were combing the area in search for killers of two policemen, securtiy sources said.
Security sources said the militants were killed earlier by policemen who were firing while conducting their search for the killers. Police sources said the three dead were the wanted assassins.

Gunmen, thought to be members of the militant Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group) fighting to overthrow the government, shot dead on Wednesday five people, including the two policemen in separate incidents.
Almost 1,000 people have been killed and scores wounded since Moslem militant groups launched in 1992 a battle to topple the government and transform Egypt into a strict Islamist state.
